chunks: I wrote to Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him): 'May God make me your ransom, O my master! It has been reported to us that God is in a place besides another place, established upon the Throne, and that He descends every night during the latter half of the night to the nearest sky; and it has been reported that He descends on the evening of Arafat, then returns to His place.'

So some of your followers said concerning this: 'If He were in one place other than another, then the atmosphere would encounter Him and surround Him, and the atmosphere is a subtle body that surrounds everything according to its measure — so how could it surround Him, Majestic is His laudation, according to this analogy?'

So he (peace be upon him) wrote back: 'The knowledge of that is with Him, and He is the One who determines it with what is the best of measurements. Know that when He is in the nearest sky, He is just as He is upon the Throne — all things are equal to Him in knowledge, power, dominion, and encompassment.'
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Isa — similarly.

key_terms.اسْتَوَى: Established upon/istawa — a controversial Quranic term interpreted metaphorically in Islamic theology
key_terms.التَّكَنُّف: Surrounding/enveloping — the philosophical argument from atmospheric physics
key_terms.الْإِحَاطَة: Encompassment — God's all-encompassing knowledge and control over all things
key_terms.الْعَرْشِ: The Throne of God — a Quranic term referring to divine sovereignty
key_terms.جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: Majestic is His laudation — an honorific expression affirming divine greatness

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali al-Hadi say about God descending from the Throne?
ai.summary: Muhammad ibn Isa posed a theological question to Imam Ali al-Hadi (AS) about anthropomorphic reports of God descending from the Throne and being confined to a specific place — and how the atmosphere would then surround a spatially located God. The Imam responded that such knowledge belongs to God alone, and affirmed divine transcendence: God's presence in the nearest sky does not imply spatial limitation, for all things are equal to Him in knowledge, power, dominion, and encompassment. This hadith is a key text in Shia kalam (theology) on the doctrine of divine transcendence (tanzih) and rejection of corporeal attributes.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa who said, 
‘I wrote to Abu Al-Hassan Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! O my master<sup>asws</sup>! It has been reported to us that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is in a place besides a (another) place, established upon the Throne, and He<sup>azwj</sup> Descends every night during the latter half from the night to the sky of the world, and it is reported that He<sup>azwj</sup> Descend on the evening of Arafaat, then He<sup>azwj</sup> Returns back to His<sup>azwj</sup> place’.

So, some of the ones in your<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah said with regards to that, ‘If it was so that He<sup>azwj</sup> was in a place besides a (another) place, so the atmosphere would have come across Him<sup>azwj</sup> and would surround upon him, and the atmosphere is a light body surrounding upon everything by its measurement. So how could it surround upon Him<sup>azwj</sup>, Majestic is His<sup>azwj</sup> Laudation, upon this example?’

So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> signed: ‘The Knowledge of that is with Him<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, and He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> is the Evaluater for it with what is the best of the measurements, and know that when He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> was in the sky of the world, so He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> it just as He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> is upon the Throne, and the thing, all of these are the same to Him<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> in Knowledge, and measurement, and domain, and control’.
And from him, from Muhammad BinJa’far Al Kufy, from Muhammad Bin Isa – similar to it.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa who has said the following. “I wrote to Imam abu al-Hassan, Ali ibn Muhammad (a.s.) to clarify a question. May Allah take my soul in your service, O my master, it is narrated to us that Allah is in one place and not in another place on ‘Arsh, (the Throne) resting. He comes down to the sky above the earth every night during the last half of the night. It is narrated that He comes down at the ninth evening of the month of Dhul Hajj and then He returns back to His place.

Certain individuals among your friends have said that if He would be found in certain places and not in other places the air must have come in contact with Him and would surround Him because air is a thin form of body that surrounds everything proportionate to its size. How then the air would surround Allah, the Most Holy and the Most High, According to this assumption?

The Imam replied in writing, “He has the knowledge of this. He is the best One in having the true measurements of all things. You must, However, note that His being in the sky over the earth is just as He on the Throne. All things to Him are the same in the matters of His knowledge and power, domination and control.”

Muhammad ibn Ja‘far al-Kufi has narrated from Muhammad ibn ’Isa a similar Hadith About the words of Allah “There is not a single place wherein any secret counsel can take place between any three people without God being the fourth, . .” [58:7].
